import torch

model.eval()
print(f'Model loaded: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())/1e6:.1f}M params')

texts = ['pick up the red cup from the table', 'grab the red cup off the table', 'open the top drawer of the cabinet']
inputs = tokenizer(texts, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=64, padding=True)
with torch.no_grad():
    outputs = model(**inputs)
    embs = outputs.pooler_output.float()
    embs = embs / embs.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True)

print(f'Embedding shape: {embs.shape}')
sim01 = (embs[0] @ embs[1]).item()
sim02 = (embs[0] @ embs[2]).item()
print(f'Sim(pick_up, grab): {sim01:.4f}')
print(f'Sim(pick_up, open_drawer): {sim02:.4f}')
print('SUCCESS')
" 2>&1
